name: MEX Berlin
blurb: An anime, manga, Korean-culture and games expo in Berlin with an Artist Alley, cosplay corner, a Japanese garden photo spot and a gaming room.

editions.evidence: Meta description: 'Vom 23. – 25. Oktober 2026 begrüßen wir euch zur MEX '26 in den Messehallen am Funkturm in Berlin.'; homepage countdown targets the same weekend.

notes: The site's own 'GÄSTE' nav link currently redirects back to the homepage and the only populated guest-style grid found is sponsors/exhibitor logos (artist alley/vendor partners, not people), so no star-guest photo roster exists yet; homepage text says 2026 booking is still 'in Vorbereitung' and invites fan suggestions. The one specific, confirmed act is the group NCHIVE, who have a homepage-announced concert and fan-signing, recorded as a text-only guest since no photo of them was found on the site.
